_: 너는 독립 검증자다. 아래 20문항을 passage+stem+ch만 보고 풀이한다.
ans/wa는 알 수 없다. 오직 본문 단서와 문법 지식만으로 판단.
각 문항마다 {id, pick, reason} 출력. mc는 pick=1~4 (1-based). written은 pick=정답 문자열.
정답 모호하면 가장 그럴듯한 것 선택 + reason에 "모호" 표기.
fullPassage: When we are 'always on' we are constantly ingesting content ― reading alerts and texts, liking, checking emails, downloading, uploading, upgrading, updating, deleting, submitting responses, and posting. If we do it while we are eating, our multi-tasking is overloading us. As our will attempts to digest the virtual content its forces are diverted from the physical content, our food. It's easy to eat a sandwich in a minute while talking on the phone. Some people are skilled at doing both at the same time. Others write a half-hearted, shorthand text while they hurriedly eat their sandwich at the same time. The result can be a misunderstood text with the need for further clarifying texts and the beginnings of nervous indigestion. Eat your sandwich. Taste it. Let it go down. Then text.
